title: Catacombs of Paris

authoredMembers.title: Catacombs of Paris · Avenue René-Coty exit

remaining: The two public stairs have independent surface placements. The revised approach to René-Coty includes the bends and Fontis junction shown in the Paris Musées planning diagram. The complete underground alignment, distance discrepancy and combined catalog placement remain open.

guidedRouteSections.title: Crypte du Sacellum
guidedRouteSections.modeledNotes: The stepped limestone altar, three wall tablets and bone-lined return are modeled in a side chamber off the draft route between the Samaritaine and the sepulchral lamp.

guidedRouteSections.title: Fontis gallery and Salle des Fontis
guidedRouteSections.modeledNotes: The Paris Musées planning diagram places the junction near the return before René-Coty. The draft follows this junction and models 247 m of gallery up to the former Fontis exit. The museum room plan supplies 83 spiral steps. The shaft center, grade and street connection beyond the upper landing remain estimated.
